text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We have a little bit of time before training starts, so Seeking the Pearl and I watch a TV special on train station bento boxes together in the meantime.

text_block_list.name: TV Reporter
text_block_list.text: Well, we certainly feasted our eyes upon a number of delicious-looking bentos today! Until next week!
choice_data_list: All right, guess it's about time we get started on training.
All right, guess it's about time we get started on training.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: …Wait, Trainer! Before that, I want to ask you about making some changes to my routine!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: We need to put the spotlight on one thing and one thing only!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Think back on all of those bento boxes we just saw and how brightly they shone… They were all unified by one main dish!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Yes! Just like a charismatic person who excites the crowd and creates waves…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: The possibilities are endless when you hone one thing to perfection!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Grilled malted pork, whole grilled seafood… Each bento had different local specialities that accented the meal.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: One day, those side dishes will evolve from mere accents to main attractions! And my body is no different—what an exciting thought!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If I understand her correctly, she must want to focus on one type of training until it's perfectly honed before moving on to the next.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haha. Let's get started, then! My possibilities may be infinite, but time certainly is not!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her bento box analogy is a bit hard to follow, but she has a point. I decide to take her motivation into account and make a new training routine for her.
